cc:Work.dc:description: Illustrative 2000 kg G=9 drivetrain. The uniform 0-60 mph in one second target requires 53.6448 kN up to 96.56064 km/h. Grip is 29.43 kN; torque force 30.8118 kN; wheel power 903.07 kW. The available force is the minimum; power curve is undefined at rest. Grip-to-power transition is 110.467 km/h. Not Tesla specifications.
